description: Every (state, event) pair of the v4 machines that has more than one transition, with its guards and why they are mutually exclusive. Guards are prose in v4, so the compiler cannot decide overlap itself; it checks instead that each such pair has exactly the guards reviewed here (X12), so adding, removing or changing a guard fails until this file is reviewed again. 'exhaustive' says whether the guards cover every case; where they do not, the remaining case fails closed. 'unusedEvents' lists events no transition accepts (check X12 requires each to be listed with an owner decision).

guards: online
known offline
groups.exclusiveBecause: network state is online or known offline

guards: online and no other mutation in flight in this tab
known offline
online and another mutation is in flight in this tab
groups.exclusiveBecause: offline; or online with or without another mutation in flight

guards: current and no change made during the save
current and changes were made during the save
groups.exclusiveBecause: a reply that is not current is SupersededReply, a different event; among current replies, changes were or were not made

guards: current and fewer than three rebase attempts made
current and three rebase attempts already made
groups.exclusiveBecause: current replies only (as above); rebase attempts are fewer than three or exactly three

guards: current and no change made during the save
current and changes were made during the save
groups.exclusiveBecause: current replies only; changes were or were not made

guards: current and mutation limit not reached
current and mutation limit reached
groups.exclusiveBecause: current replies only; the four-mutation limit is reached or not

guards: current; investigation files unchanged; rebase limit not reached
current; investigation files unchanged; rebase limit reached
groups.exclusiveBecause: current replies with unchanged files; if the files changed the event is a conflict path, which fails closed here

guards: online, Retry can succeed, credential accepted
known offline
groups.exclusiveBecause: online with Retry impossible or a refused credential is not listed: Retry is not offered (PERSIST-031) and a request fails closed

guards: online and a save request is waiting
known offline and a save request is waiting
groups.exclusiveBecause: without a waiting request the event cannot occur and fails closed

guards: current and known offline
current and online
groups.exclusiveBecause: current replies only; online or known offline

guards: online and connected
offline
groups.exclusiveBecause: online but not connected is not listed: Open is not offered before Connect, and a request fails closed

unusedEvents.finding: The event is declared by v4 but no transition accepts it, so it fails closed in every state.
